title: VooPoo Argus Klyc Pod Vape Kit
description: The Voopoo Argus Klyc is a slim and stylish pod vape kit that blends intelligent performance with everyday practicality. Built around Voopoo’s advanced GENE.AI 2.0 chipset, this kit delivers up to 30W of adaptive output power and a range of automatic safety features, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping styles. Powered by a 1350mAh internal battery, the Klyc offers long-lasting use between charges and supports USB-C fast charging for minimal downtime. The draw-activated system features real-time output adjustment based on your inhale strength, delivering a smooth and consistent vape across all supported coil types. Three LED indicators show battery level, output strength, and pod detection at a glance. The Klyc includes a top-fill Argus Cartridge V2 with a 0.7ohm integrated coil and 2ml e-liquid capacity. The device also supports the wider Argus pod family, including 0.4ohm and 1.0ohm variants, offering excellent flexibility with both Nic Salt and 50/50 e-liquids. A side airflow control slider allows fine-tuning between tight and airy draws. One of the Klyc’s most distinctive features is its magnetic protective cap, designed to keep the mouthpiece clean when not in use. The cap attaches magnetically to the top or base of the device for convenience and helps reduce exposure to dust and bacteria. The Voopoo Argus Klyc is a user-friendly yet feature-rich pod system ideal for those seeking a reliable, modern vape that adapts intuitively to their needs. We recommend using the following E-Liquid: Voopoo Argus V2 0.7ohm Pod - Use Nic Salts or 50/50 (freebase) Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen vape liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
